public_summary.title: Service observation window
observed_symptoms: Request latency and error rate observation window

decisions.reason: Initial triage: identify any deployment/config changes near the observation window and quantify latency/error onset across candidate services before forming hypotheses.

assignments.question: List all deployments, config changes, maintenance, and scaling events for gateway, backend, postgres, redis, or payment in the observation window (starting 2026-10-01T12:00:00Z). For any change that could affect latency/errors, retrieve its config diff and record the change timestamp. Distinguish changes that predate the observed symptoms from changes that follow them.
assignments.reason: A deployment or config change is a common causal source for sudden latency/error changes; establishing the change timeline is required before attributing causality.
assignments.expected_discriminator: Presence or absence of a change whose timestamp aligns with the observed latency/error degradation.

assignments.question: Query request latency and error rate metrics for gateway, backend, payment, redis, and postgres from 2026-10-01T12:00:00Z to 2026-10-01T13:00:00Z. Compare the series to identify which service shows the earliest and most severe degradation, and note the approximate onset time.
assignments.reason: Latency and error metrics will locate the affected service and onset time, constraining which change or dependency is causal rather than merely correlated.
assignments.expected_discriminator: A service whose latency/error metrics degrade first and worst, enabling comparison with the change timeline.
